name: monbo
description: Root orchestrator for the Monbo monorepo (option A: delegates to each package; no pnpm workspace). A minimal root lockfile pins the concurrently devDependency.

scripts.dev: pnpm exec concurrently -n front,api -c blue,green "pnpm --dir apps/web dev" "uv run --directory apps/api fastapi dev app/main.py"
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir apps/web lint && uv run --directory apps/api ruff check . && uv run --directory apps/api black --check . && uv run --directory apps/api mypy app
